correctness.rationale: The proof applies the inspected Lemma 3.3 of arXiv:2306.10738 under \(a=R_n\), \(a\ge n-2\) and \(k=n-1\), verifies \(R_{n+j}=b^jR_n+R_j\), derives the greedy height \(q_n\) recursion including the terminal \(bR_{n-1}\) boundary, and proves each positive height jump is exactly \(b\). Each positive jump gives precisely \(b\) terminal missing suffixes; multiples of \(R_n\) separate them. The disjoint jump recurrence proves the complete histogram and factorized polynomial, including \(n=2\). Embedded CHECKER.py confirms 26 parameter cases, 8,585 blocks and shortest-path Apéry representatives, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The maximal missing-integer-block length spectrum is a natural refinement of Frobenius/genus for an entire classical semigroup family; a completely factored \(b^{n-1}\)-length polynomial with every nonzero coefficient equal to \(b\), sharp endpoints and exact block count is mathematically informative and reusable. It is not a finite table, arbitrary special-case slice, a mere normalized sign/zero observation, or only a new representation of the known genus.
